$comment: Scope + policy for the claim-verification gate. See scripts/verify/README.md. Everything the gate looks at is named HERE — a document that is not listed is deliberately ungoverned, not accidentally missed.

ungoverned.$comment: Not scanned, and each exclusion is a reason rather than an oversight.
ungoverned.docs/Research/**: imported research dumps — a record of what was read, not a claim this repo makes
ungoverned.docs/g2-raw/**: raw preference-study output; numbers, not assertions about the codebase
ungoverned.docs/g2_5-results.md: study results — assertions about a study, not about this tree
ungoverned.docs/g2-preregistration.md: pre-registered study protocol, frozen by design
ungoverned.docs/VetTrack-Readiness-Review.md: point-in-time external review; superseded by the gate itself

crossRepoPrefixes.reason: cross-repo: Express server lives in the vettrack (Capacitor) repo, which this repo deliberately never touches
cross-repo: vettrack's web page components; RN has no src/pages
cross-repo: vettrack workspace package; reachable here only as the gitignored .vendor/ snapshot
cross-repo: vettrack's shared/ workspace; vendored, not checked in
cross-repo: vettrack's Capacitor shell composition; RN has no src/native

siblingRepo: exposwifty31/vettrack (the Capacitor repo; same engine as scripts/verify/*.cjs)
